metadata.description: Give Claude a video input. /watch downloads, extracts frames (scene detection + OCR), transcribes via captions or Whisper (local GPU, Groq, OpenAI, or AssemblyAI diarization), and hands it all to Claude — or routes the whole video through a Gemini or OpenRouter backend.

plugins.name: watch
plugins.description: Watch a video (URL or local path) with a Claude, Gemini, or OpenRouter backend. Downloads with yt-dlp, extracts frames with ffmpeg (scene detection + OCR), transcribes via captions or Whisper (local, Groq, OpenAI, or AssemblyAI diarization).
